purpose: Test LayerCake's intended separation of capability steering from English realization: the selected capability cake steers the first output decision, then the immutable English core realizes the continuation.

measured_trigger.finding: The v24 capability cake, not the frozen transformer or tokenizer, is the remaining source of long-form trajectory drift. Keeping the cake active on every generated token conflates capability injection with English realization.

architecture.physical_execution_claim: The cake residual is multiplied by the runtime-bound activation scalar before the residual add; the English core remains active.

locked_sequence.purpose: Diagnostic: measure whether the exact full vocabulary returns toward the sealed parent token trajectory.

locked_sequence.source_artifact: The byte/EOS dynamic graph with a nested token reserve collected from sealed-parent outputs on the same hash-ordered train-only long-form prompts.
locked_sequence.purpose: Promotion candidate: retain parent-like token choices without a full output projection.

parent_train_reserve.selection_order: Reuse the exact first 32 then first 128 hash-ordered prompts from the existing train-only calibration evidence.

execution_and_stop_rule.diagnostic: Run the unchanged sustained schedule on the full-head gated graph. Continue only if median generated tokens improve by at least 20 percent relative to the ungated v24 full head.
runtime_pass: median throughput ratio to Qwen at least 2.0
paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at least 2.0
at least 95 percent sealed Phase 2 parent median throughput
all TTFT, RSS, active-memory, persistent-state, UTF-8, and collapse gates pass
execution_and_stop_rule.after_runtime_pass: Run all 1,400 ABI validation rows, all 420/43,089 general-English validation rows, the 120-observation headline benchmark, exact graph schedule proof, physical proof, identity, and adversarial generation.
execution_and_stop_rule.early_stop: Stop at the first nested reserve passing every gate.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If parent_longform_128 fails quality or speed, close core-realization scheduling and preserve all negative evidence.

claim_boundary: This schedule is not promoted merely for speed. It must preserve ABI capability behavior while proving that installed capabilities steer and the English core realizes fluent output.
